description: Indoor party band, congas: short, stocky, barrel-chested man of about fifty-five, thick grey moustache, smooth bald head.
traits: short, stocky, barrel-chested man of about fifty-five, thick grey moustache, smooth bald head
demeanor: the joker of the band: grinning, eyes on the dancers

garments.text: smooth bald head with a thick neat grey moustache
closed cream shirt with a small midnight-violet bow tie
long-sleeved cream dinner jacket with narrow midnight-violet lapels
polished two-tone cream and dark shoes

drawing.fits: his head, both shoes, both hands and both drums
drawing.look: short, stocky, barrel-chested adult build, round belly, thick arms, short neck, round cheerful face with crinkled eyes and a wide open grin, warm tan skin, smooth bald head, thick neat grey moustache, long-sleeved cream dinner jacket buttoned closed, its narrow midnight-violet satin lapels lying flat on the chest, a small midnight-violet bow tie at a closed cream shirt collar, slim dark charcoal trousers and polished two-tone cream and dark shoes, and thick dark ink outline, behind a pair of slim barrel-shaped conga drums of dark reddish wood with cream drumheads and brass bands
drawing.extra: He is a grown man of about fifty-five. The two slim conga drums stand close beside his legs, one toward each side of the picture, their cream heads at the height of his hips and his hands on top of them, with his legs and both shoes showing in the gap between them.

front.description: standing square facing the viewer behind the two conga drums, feet apart, elbows out, both open hands lying flat on top of the cream drumheads, in plain sight
